title: 15.29. Rūpīduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Arūpiṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naarūpī nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Arūpiṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naarūpī naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Rūpiṁ abyākataṁ dhammaṁ paccayā narūpī naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
